cleavage_agent: samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin and the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography
enrichment_method: phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography
fractionation_method: the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography
instrument: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
labeling: inferred: No labeling strategy is mentioned in the MS sections; samples were analyzed by LC-MS/MS with spectral counting used for quantification: 'Total spectral counts (TSC) were used to approximate each site's abundance within each tissue.'
